BiblicalUsage: To bake — Lot baking unleavened bread for his guests in Sodom, Israel baking unleavened cakes in the rush out of Egypt, the woman of Endor baking unleavened bread for Saul, and the two wave loaves baked with leaven for the feast. Bread baked in a hurry and bread baked for a feast share the one word.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that bread in the Bible is never just food: it is hospitality in Sodom, deliverance in Egypt, and worship at the feast. I believe the God who provides the bread is the one the bread always points to.
